steps.content:
The two listings are identical in everything they show, so I can't give you a real reason to pick one over the other.

| | Brackmoor Sound (A) | Ottervale Audio (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Box contents | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The rating and review count are exactly the same on both pages. That may mean they're the product's reviews shown on both listings, not each seller's own. So the rating probably tells you nothing about the sellers themselves.

Some things you could check before buying:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own ratings or reviews on a third-party site. The listings don't show any.
- **Final price:** Check at checkout for differences in tax or fees.
- **Warranty:** Find out whether it's honored by the manufacturer or only by the seller.
- **Return process:** Look at the fine print for restocking fees or a return authorization requirement.

If none of that separates them, either one is fine. I'd go with whichever has the better seller reputation or the smoother checkout.
